entities.summary: Nana Osei Bandoh, better known by his ring name, Prince Nana, is an American professional wrestling manager and former professional wrestler of Ghanaian descent. He is signed to All Elite Wrestling (AEW), where he serves as the on-screen manager of Swerve Strickland. He is also known for his tenure in Ring of Honor (ROH), where he was the founder and on-screen manager of The Embassy stable.
